title: RvContracts
description: Restaurant Vision contracts, schema version 1.2. Generated by rv_contracts.schema_export; do not edit.

AckVia.description: Where an acknowledgement was pressed. Never who pressed it.
AckVia.title: AckVia

AlertAckCommand.description:
An alert was acknowledged in the cloud (waiter app). The edge applies it and emits
``alert.acknowledged`` with ``via="cloud"`` and this ``ack_at``.
AlertAckCommand.title: AlertAckCommand

AlertAcknowledged.description: Someone pressed "on it". No user identity, by design.

ts.description: When it happened, Unix epoch seconds (UTC) on the edge clock.

ack_at.description: When the button was pressed (for cloud acks: the cloud's receive time).

AlertAcknowledged.title: AlertAcknowledged

AlertPush.description:
Body of a Web Push message, sent for a newly raised alert that is still unresolved
when its ingest batch completes. Anonymous: no user, no staff identity. Since 1.1.

table_label.description: Label of the alert's table; None for ``long_queue``.

condition_since_ts.description: When the condition began (e.g. guests seated); None if unknown: use ``raised_at``.

AlertPush.title: AlertPush

AlertRaised.description: A new alert. Table alerts carry ``table_id``; ``long_queue`` carries ``zone_id``.

ts.description: When it happened, Unix epoch seconds (UTC) on the edge clock.

condition_since_ts.description:
When the underlying condition began (``<= ts``): ``waiter_needed`` = guests seated,
``checkin_needed`` = last staff attention, ``bussing_needed`` = guests left,
``long_queue`` = the threshold was crossed. Staff apps show "waiting 3:20" from here, not
from ``ts``. None if unknown (1.0 producers): use ``ts``. Since 1.1.

AlertRaised.title: AlertRaised

ts.description: When it happened, Unix epoch seconds (UTC) on the edge clock.

AlertStatus.description:
Derived alert status. ``GET /alerts?status=open`` returns every unresolved alert
(``open`` and ``acknowledged``).
AlertStatus.title: AlertStatus

AlertView.description: An alert as shown to staff. Acks carry time and channel only, never a person.

condition_since_ts.description:
When the underlying condition began (``AlertRaised.condition_since_ts``), e.g. when the
guests were seated for ``waiter_needed``. Show elapsed time ("waiting 3:20") from here,
falling back to ``raised_at`` when None. Since 1.1.

AlertView.title: AlertView

Anchor.description: Which point of a person's box is tested against zones.
Anchor.title: Anchor

Bucket.description: Time-series bucket width. ``1d`` buckets follow the site's local midnight.
Bucket.title: Bucket

CameraConfig.description: One camera as the analytics sees it. No URL or credentials (see module docstring).

anchor.description: Point of each person box tested against zones.

target_fps.description: Frames per second analysed; the source drops frames down to this rate.

privacy_masks.description: Polygons blacked out before detection (merged with ``privacy`` zones).

CameraConfig.title: CameraConfig

last_frame_age_s.description: Seconds since the last frame; None if no frame since the edge started.

CameraSource.description: Where frames come from. Connection details (URLs, credentials) stay on the edge.
CameraSource.title: CameraSource

cursor.description: Opaque; send as ``after`` on the next poll. Unchanged when there is nothing new.

ConfigChangedCommand.description: The site config changed in the cloud; the edge re-fetches ``GET /edge/config``.
ConfigChangedCommand.title: ConfigChangedCommand

DeviceStatus.description: An edge device and its latest heartbeat (None fields: no heartbeat yet).
DeviceStatus.title: DeviceStatus

ts.description: When it happened, Unix epoch seconds (UTC) on the edge clock.

cpu_pct.description: Process CPU usage in percent of one core (may exceed 100 on multi-core).

outbox_depth.description: Events persisted but not yet delivered to the cloud.

local_url.description:
The edge's LAN base URL (e.g. ``http://192.168.1.20:8787``), for the waiter app's
offline link (``<local_url>/local-alerts``). None if unknown. Since 1.1.

started_at.description:
When the edge runtime started (its clock). A newer value than the cloud has seen means
the edge restarted and lost its in-memory alerts and table states: the cloud expires the
site's alerts raised before it and resets table states changed before it. Since 1.2.

Estimate.description: A derived figure that the UI must label as an estimate.

value.description: None when there is not enough data.

Estimate.title: Estimate

EventType.description: Value of the ``type`` discriminator of every :data:`EdgeEvent`.
EventType.title: EventType

duplicates.description: Events whose ``event_id`` was already stored (ignored, still a success).

FloorPlanItem.description: Position of a table on the dashboard's schematic floor-plan grid (not camera space).

x.description: Grid column, 0-based, from the start edge (right in RTL).

FloorPlanItem.title: FloorPlanItem

Line.description: Directed counting line ``a -> b`` (e.g. the entrance into the dining room).

in_direction.description:
Which crossing is inward: ``left_to_right`` makes the right-hand side of ``a -> b``
(as seen on screen) the inside.

Line.title: Line

LineDirection.description: Which crossing of a directed line ``a -> b`` counts as inward (see module docstring).
LineDirection.title: LineDirection

LiveSnapshotMessage.description:
WebSocket state message: the full live state, sent alongside ``EdgeEvent`` messages
(see the module docstring). Replaces the client's cached ``LiveSnapshot``. Since 1.1.
LiveSnapshotMessage.title: LiveSnapshotMessage

Locale.description: UI and report language. Hebrew is right-to-left.
Locale.title: Locale

Me.description: ``GET /me``: the signed-in user, their org, roles and the sites they can open.

sites.description: Sites this user can access (all org sites for owners).

Me.title: Me

MembershipInfo.description: A role grant. Owners have ``site_id=None`` (all sites); managers and waiters one site.
MembershipInfo.title: MembershipInfo

MetricsSummary.description: KPIs of one site over ``[from_ts, to_ts)``.

sessions.description: Table sessions closed in the range.

turnover_per_table.description: Sessions per table (sessions / number of tables).

MetricsSummary.title: MetricsSummary

Modules.description: Analytics modules enabled for the site (plans gate them; see architecture 4).
Modules.title: Modules

ts.description: When it happened, Unix epoch seconds (UTC) on the edge clock.

guests.description: Guests at tables plus guests in ``area`` zones.

staff_on_floor.description:
Staff tracks currently seen on the floor, summed over cameras (role ``staff``: uniform
colour or first seen in a ``staff_area``). Anonymous and approximate: a person seen by two
overlapping cameras counts twice, and staff inside ``staff_area`` zones (kitchen pass,
service station) are included. Never attributed to a person.

OrgUser.description: A user as listed in user management.
OrgUser.title: OrgUser

token.description: Device bearer token; stored only in the edge's local secrets file.

PairingCodeInfo.description: A one-time code shown in the dashboard and typed into ``rv-edge pair``.
PairingCodeInfo.title: PairingCodeInfo

PushSubscriptionIn.description:
``POST /push/subscriptions``. From the browser's ``PushSubscription.toJSON()``:
``endpoint`` and ``keys``; ``expirationTime`` is not used.
PushSubscriptionIn.title: PushSubscriptionIn

QueueSeated.description: A queued person crossed the entrance line inward.

ts.description: When it happened, Unix epoch seconds (UTC) on the edge clock.

zone_id.description: The queue zone they waited in.

QueueSeated.title: QueueSeated

ts.description: When it happened, Unix epoch seconds (UTC) on the edge clock.

parties_est.description: Estimated number of parties (tracks entering within 5 s and close together).

avg_wait_s.description: Mean current wait of people in the queue (0 when empty).

QueueWalkaway.description: A party left the queue outward after ``walkaway_min_wait_s`` without being seated.

ts.description: When it happened, Unix epoch seconds (UTC) on the edge clock.

QueueWalkaway.title: QueueWalkaway

RoiBlock.description: ROI figures (architecture 7.4). Everything here is an estimate.

response_time_baseline_p50_s.description: ``waiter_needed`` p50 over the first 7 days after install.

extra_covers.description: Extra guests from faster turns, counted only in hours with a non-empty queue.

RoiBlock.title: RoiBlock

SignupRequest.description: Creates an organization and its owner.
SignupRequest.title: SignupRequest

SiteConfig.description: Everything the edge needs to run analytics for one site.

config_version.description: Incremented by the cloud on every save; used as ETag. 0 = never saved.

SiteConfig.title: SiteConfig

SiteSettings.description:
``GET /sites/{site_id}``. Thresholds and modules are also part of ``SiteConfig``;
changing them here bumps ``config_version`` and notifies the edge (``config_changed``).

avg_check_per_guest.description: Average spend per guest, used for ROI estimates.

SiteSettings.title: SiteSettings

SiteSettingsPatch.description: ``PATCH /sites/{site_id}``: omitted fields are unchanged; nested objects are replaced.
SiteSettingsPatch.title: SiteSettingsPatch

SiteSummary.description: A site card in the org overview.

guests.description: Guests now (latest occupancy snapshot); None if no data yet.

edge_online.description: At least one device sent a heartbeat within ``DEVICE_OFFLINE_AFTER_S``.

SiteSummary.title: SiteSummary

Table.description: A physical table. ``table_id`` is stable; ``label`` is what staff call it.
Table.title: Table

since_ts.description:
When the current state really started (backdated to the evidence, see
``TableStateChanged.since_ts``; the transition time for 1.0 producers). None if unknown
(no event yet).

TableSessionClosed.description: A seating ended (guests left). Emitted once per session.

ts.description: When it happened, Unix epoch seconds (UTC) on the edge clock.

left_at.description: When guests left (start of ``needs_bussing``). Dwell = ``left_at - seated_at``.

first_visit_delay_s.description: Seconds from ``seated_at`` to the first staff visit; None if never visited.

visits.description: Number of staff visits during the session.

bussing_delay_s.description: Seconds from ``left_at`` to bussed; None if not known when the session closed.

TableSessionClosed.title: TableSessionClosed

TableStateChanged.description: A table moved to another state.

ts.description: When it happened, Unix epoch seconds (UTC) on the edge clock.

guest_count.description: Smoothed number of guests at the table at transition time.

session_id.description: The seating this transition belongs to (see module docstring).

since_ts.description:
When ``to_state`` really began (backdated to the evidence, ``<= ts``): first guest
sighting for ``seated``, waiter arrival for ``attended``, last guest sighting for
``needs_bussing``. None if unknown (1.0 producers): use ``ts``. Since 1.1.

TableStateChanged.title: TableStateChanged

Thresholds.description: Per-site analytics timing (architecture 5.1/6.2). Seconds unless the name says otherwise.

seat_confirm_s.description: Guests continuously present this long: ``empty -> seated`` (opens a session).

leave_confirm_s.description: No guests this long: ``seated|attended -> needs_bussing`` (closes the session).

staff_visit_min_s.description: Staff track in a table zone this long counts as a visit.

first_visit_timeout_s.description: ``seated`` without a visit this long raises ``waiter_needed``.

checkin_timeout_s.description: ``attended`` without a visit this long raises ``checkin_needed``.

bussing_visit_min_s.description: Staff visit this long during ``needs_bussing``: table is bussed (``-> empty``).

walkaway_min_wait_s.description: Queue tracks leaving outward after waiting at least this long count as walk-aways.

long_queue_people.description: People in a queue zone at or above which ``long_queue`` is raised.

long_queue_wait_s.description: Longest queue wait at or above which ``long_queue`` is raised.

count_window_s.description: Rolling-median window for smoothing guest counts.

track_id_ttl_h.description: Hours before track id mappings rotate. At most 24 (privacy: rotated at least daily).

Thresholds.title: Thresholds

points.description: One point per bucket in range, ascending.

value.description: None when the bucket has no data.

password.description: Initial password, changed by the user later.

UserUpdate.description: Partial update; omitted fields are unchanged.
UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate

public_key.description: URL-safe base64 VAPID application server key.

WsCloseCode.description: Close codes of the cloud ``WS /ws`` when it refuses a connection. Since 1.1.
WsCloseCode.title: WsCloseCode

Zone.description: A polygon or line on one camera image (normalized coordinates).

polygon.description: Required for every kind except ``entrance_line``; must be None for ``entrance_line``.

line.description: Required for ``entrance_line``; must be None otherwise.

table_id.description: Required for ``table`` zones; must be None otherwise.

primary.description: ``table`` zones only: this camera is the one that counts the table.

Zone.title: Zone

ZoneKind.description: What a zone means to the analytics (architecture 6.2).
ZoneKind.title: ZoneKind
